articles.txt:
Entre deux sessions de GTA 6, on a compilé les films cultes qui ont inspiré le nouveau volet de la saga à succès de Rockstar.
Difficile de ne pas citer le film de Nicolas Winding Refn, Drive , sorti en 2011 et porté par Ryan Gosling. On suit un cascadeur automobile, qui opère à Hollywood le jour, pour mieux devenir le chauffeur de braqueurs la nuit. Ténébreux, taiseux, celui qui n’a jamais de prénom tout au long du film a un code de conduite strict et s’applique à ne s’impliquer dans les contrats qu’on lui donne, jusqu’à que sa route croise celle de nouveaux voisins, Irène, Standard et leur fils Benicio, l’entrainant dans une spirale de violence.
Drive est lié à GTA 6 par l’importance que revêt la conduite automobile dans cet épisode , ce qui a toujours été le cas d’ailleurs dans l’histoire de la saga. Mais il met en avant un personnage qui n’est pas à proprement parler un criminel et qui va tout de même se retrouver mêlé à une sombre histoire, ce qui est un peu le postulat de base de n’importe quel joueur avant de se lancer dans une partie de GTA .
Enfin, le réalisateur de Drive, Nicolas Winding Refn, a confié s’être inspiré de l’esthétique de la franchise pour son film. Pas étonnant de voir, en écho, GTA 6 et la ville de Vice City reprendre la même atmosphère rétro-chic et les éclairages néon nocturnes du long-métrage de 2011. Sans parler de la bande-originale de Justice qui rappelle évidemment le travail de Kavinsky.
GTA 6 nous a proposé quelques plans, qui ne sont pas sans rappeler l’esthétique du film de Michael Mann. Miami Vice : Deux flics à Miami est devenu culte après sa sortie en salles, notamment pour sa réalisation et son grain d’image, poisseux et sale, et qui a parfois donné des allures de documentaire à l’adaptation de la célèbre série TV. Le film de 2006 nous plonge dans une ville de Miami plus sombre que celle présentée dans les années 80 sur le petit écran.
C’est peut-être aussi pour cela que Michael Mann va remettre le couvert en 2028, avec Miami Vice 85’ , une nouvelle adaptation cinématographique portée par Austin Butler et Michael B. Jordan, censée être plus proche de la série télévisée. La scène d’ouverture du film de 2006, dans la boite de nuit, qui mélange alcool, trafics, violence et prostituées, est un parfait condensé de ce qui nous attend le 19 septembre dans GTA 6.
Il aurait dû être le premier de notre liste, puisqu’il est celui qui a le plus de points communs avec la licence Grand Theft Auto . GTA, c’est finalement la meilleure adaptation de Scarface en jeu vidéo. Le film de Brian de Palma est un chef d’oeuvre du film noir et la meilleure définition, en un peu moins de trois heures, du rise and fall à l’américaine. On suit l’ascension fulgurante de Tony Montana, un réfugié cubain, qui va s’installer au sommet du trafic de cocaïne, avant de connaître une lente descente aux enfers.
Comme Scarface lors de sa sortie en salles, GTA (1997) a été pris au cœur de la polémique avant de devenir le jeu vidéo culte qu’on connaît. La ville de Miami, centrale dans l’histoire de Scarface , a inspiré la ville fictive et désormais emblématique de Vice City. Enfin, la progression de Tony, jalonnée d’alliances et de trahisons, est une des bases majeures du scénario des différents épisodes de GTA et notamment GTA : Vice City.
Le film de Derek Cianfrance, sorti en 2012, est parmi les premiers que l’on cite lorsqu’on évoque GTA 6 et ses références cinématographiques. Le couple que que forme Jason Duval et Lucia Caminos dans le nouvel épisode de la licence à succès de Rockstar rappelle énormément celui de The Place Beyond The Pines . Jason a des similitudes physiques avec Luke Glanton, incarné par Ryan Gosling, tout comme Lucia avec Romina, jouée elle par Eva Mendes.
Le film nous montre des scènes de braquages en duo, élément que retrouve dans GTA 6, avec un plan montrant Jason et Lucia braquer une épicerie avec des foulards sur le visage. L’histoire lie aussi les deux projets.
Dans The Place Beyond The Pines , c’est la précarité et la protection de leur fils Jason qui pousse Luke et Romina à franchir la ligne. Là encore, le clin d’oeil est évident.
Probablement le film le plus évident, compte-tenu de la dimension émotionnelle que veut apporter GTA 6 à l’ensemble de la licence. Le plus évident aussi, car comme The Place Beyond The Pines , Bonnie et Clyde met en scène un couple d’amants qui bascule dans la criminalité, là encore en raison d’une vie sociale et économique beaucoup trop dure.

articles.t: GTA VI : vous rêvez de découvrir Vice City ? Les recherches de logements dans la ville qui l'a inspirée ont bondi de 55% | TF1 Info
articles.chapeau: [VIDÉO] Ce jeudi 19 novembre est sorti "GTA VI", le jeu vidéo le plus attendu de l’année. Les joueurs vont redécouvrir la ville de Vice City, inspirée de Miami. Un engouement qui dépasse le cadre des écrans puisque les recherches de logements dans la ville floridienne ont bondi de 55% sur Expedia, par rapport à la même période en 2025. - GTA VI : vous rêvez de découvrir Vice City ? Les recherches de logements dans la ville qui l'a inspirée ont bondi de 55% (Voyages).
articles.txt:
Si le set-jetting représente une tendance voyage qui consiste à se rendre sur les lieux de tournage de ses films et séries préférés, le jeu vidéo inspire lui aussi des destinations. Avec l’engouement de la sortie de GTA VI ce jeudi 19 novembre, la perspective de marcher dans les pas des protagonistes Jason et Lucia séduit déjà les aficionados de la franchise de Rockstar. Selon les données communiquées par Expedia France, les recherches de logements à Miami ont augmenté de 55% sur la plateforme depuis le 15 octobre 2026, par rapport à la même période en 2025.
Miami est la ville qui a inspiré Vice City, la cité fictive du jeu située dans l'État de Leonida. Cette dernière était d’ailleurs déjà au cœur du jeu GTA Vice City, sorti en 2002. Pour proposer une expérience encore plus vraie que nature, Rockstar a cette fois-ci créé une carte beaucoup plus grande, avec une superficie avoisinant les 125 km² à 160 km² selon les zones et estimations de la communauté, soit environ le double de celle de GTA 5. De quoi donner une nouvelle source d’exploration et donner envie de se rendre pour de vrai sur les lieux qui l’ont inspiré.
Miami est au cœur de la campagne du jeu. De nombreux endroits de la ville de Floride ont même été décorés aux couleurs de Vice City pour l’occasion. Pourtant, elle n’est pas la seule à profiter de cet engouement. Les recherches de logements à Panama City, toujours en Floride, ont progressé de 65% sur la même période. La station balnéaire aurait notamment inspiré Port Gellhorn, une ville côtière de l’univers du jeu.
Selon Expedia, cette tendance illustre l’envie de certains joueurs de passer "de la manette au passeport" et de découvrir les paysages qui ont nourri l’imaginaire des développeurs. Cet intérêt pour les destinations associées aux jeux vidéo s’inscrit aussi dans une tendance plus large appelée "retour à l’enfance", identifiée par Expedia dans son rapport annuel sur les tendances voyages de 2027. "Avec la sortie d’un titre aussi culte, on voit à quel point le besoin de déconnecter du quotidien et de retrouver une forme d’insouciance est fort chez les adultes", explique Xavier Rousselou, porte-parole d’Expedia, dans un communiqué.
Les vacances en solo deviennent aussi un terrain de rencontres : "60% ont noué une amitié durable" grâce au sport
Au-delà de son lien avec GTA, Miami possède de nombreux attraits pour les voyageurs. Comme le souligne le média spécialisé en architecture ArchDaily (nouvelle fenêtre) , la ville ne se résume pas à ses plages, ses palmiers et ses tours face à l’océan. Son paysage urbain raconte aussi une histoire faite de migrations, de tourisme et de transformations successives.
Les amateurs d’architecture peuvent notamment découvrir le quartier Art déco de South Beach, connu pour ses façades géométriques et ses couleurs pastel, ou encore les bâtiments du courant Miami Modern, reconnaissables à leurs formes exubérantes.
La ville compte également de nombreuses réalisations contemporaines, comme le New World Center, conçu par Frank Gehry, ou le Pérez Art Museum Miami, imaginé par les architectes Herzog & de Meuron. D’autres lieux permettent de découvrir l’histoire et l’évolution de la ville, comme les quartiers de Little Havana et Wynwood, qui se sont développés avec l’arrivée des communautés cubaines et portoricaines.

articles.chapeau: L’équipe d’animation d’une résidence pour personnes âgées de Serris, en Seine-et-Marne, a fait essayer le jeu vidéo phénomène aux habitants.
articles.txt:
Les gangsters ont du souci à se faire : la concurrence arrive ! Une résidence pour seniors de Serris, en Seine-et-Marne, a proposé à ses habitants de s’essayer à GTA VI , ont rapporté Le Parisien et ICI Paris-Île-de-France. Le jeu qui permet d’incarner des criminels arpentant les rues de « Vice City » et sa sortie – très attendue – cette semaine a été commentée et suivie jusque dans la sphère politique .
Si les seniors ne sont pas forcément le cœur de cible, les retraités de cette résidence seine-et-marnaise ont semblé conquis par le jeu, qui a aussi été encensé par la presse spécialisée . « C’est le top du top » , a complimenté Lucienne, 86 ans, bluffée par le graphisme qui lui fait penser à « un vrai film » . « Je vais demander ça à mes enfants pour Noël » , a déclaré l’octogénaire citée par Le Parisien , qui ne connaissait pas du tout le jeu avant de l’essayer.
La brutalité de GTA VI, elle aussi très commentée, a-t-elle gêné ces seniors ? « Ils étaient entre deux sentiments » , a affirmé Karine Gomes, responsable de l’animation interrogée par ICI, dont vous pouvez visionner la vidéo ci-dessous . S’ils ont été interpellés par le fait que le jeu est « assez violent » , les retraités ont aussi été pris dans l’histoire et touchés par les difficultés de certains personnages. « C’était très marrant » à voir, a-t-elle glissé, expliquant vouloir proposer de nouvelles expériences aux habitants de la résidence.

Certains des gangsters en herbe étaient même fiers de leur progrès, à l’image de Jacqueline, interrogée dans la vidéo d’ICI Paris. « Je n’avais jamais touché à une manette avant ce matin 9 heures et à 14h30, je pêchais deux paquets de drogue ! » , a résumé la femme de 82 ans, qui assure que GTA VI l’a « coupée de [sa] vie présente » et lui a « fait un bien inouï » .
L’histoire ne dit pas si les participants à l’animation vont vraiment poursuivre leur expérience de « gamers » . Une chose est sûre : leurs aventures sur GTA VI ont beaucoup touché et amusé les internautes, qui ont été plus de 1,3 million à visionner la vidéo d’ICI publiée sur X. « Ils sont super cools » , salue un commentaire, tandis qu’un autre félicite une « très belle initiative » … et s’amuse d’imaginer « les enfants qui vont devoir acheter [console] + GTA à mamie pour Noël » .

articles.t: Cyberleek resurfaces with a GTA 6 Xbox build leak that's not playable yet
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek has reportedly leaked a massive GTA 6 Xbox build, though doubts remain due to missing files and the leaker's history of cryptocurrency controversies.
articles.txt:
Gaming News Current Deals New Game Releases Free Games Hardware News TOP Sponsored Cyberleek resurfaces with a GTA 6 Xbox build leak ... Dark mode Massive GTA 6 Xbox leak could become playable on PC within just a week GAMING NEWS manhkbrady - 9 minutes ago What Cyberleak Released The controversial leaker Cyberleek has resurfaced with another GTA 6-related release, this time distributing what is reportedly a decrypted build of the Xbox version . The 209GB package is already circulating across piracy networks, potentially giving PC enthusiasts a starting point for running Rockstar's upcoming game outside its intended console environment. However, anyone hoping to play it on Windows will run into one significant problem: the download reportedly lacks the executable file needed to launch the game.
Cyberleek's website now features a message announcing the latest leak, accompanied by images showing the Xbox build's file structure and various game assets. Unlike earlier gameplay footage, which reportedly came from a PC-based development build, this release consists of files from the console version. Cyberleek claims the build dates back to November 2026, although its usefulness remains limited without the missing .exe.
As with previous announcements, Cyberleek is attempting to raise cryptocurrency funds before releasing the remaining file. The leaker previously tied access to a playable build to a meme coin reaching a $30 million market capitalization, but that campaign failed in October. The latest target is reportedly $15 million, at which point Cyberleek promises to release the executable.
Even if the missing file eventually becomes available, turning the Xbox build into a playable Windows version will be far from straightforward. Cyberleek believes hackers could find a way to emulate the Xbox Series X version on PC within a week, potentially allowing sufficiently powerful hardware to overcome the game's reported 30 FPS performance target . However, there is currently no working Series X emulator capable of running commercial games of this complexity.
The Xbox Series X and modern PCs do share some underlying hardware characteristics, including the x86-64 CPU architecture. That alone is not enough to make console games compatible with Windows, however. Microsoft's console uses a customized operating system and software environment, which would need to be replicated or adapted before the leaked files could run on a PC.
Cyberleek has also claimed to possess a PS5 build as a backup option. Beyond the cryptocurrency fundraising effort, the leaker says the broader objective is to prevent Take-Two and Rockstar from maximizing their earnings through separate console and PC releases. Whether any of these claims lead to a functioning PC version remains uncertain.

Grand Theft Auto VI’s Chapter 3 missions have all been building to this: the cartel bank heist. Raul is ready to go. In this official IGN GTA 6 guide , learn what you need to do to make it possible to execute a perfect heist.
Below are all the heist preparation missions, including specific objectives, that impact the time and equipment you’ll have for the mission. The first two below don't impact the time you'll have.
Depending on your success completing all preparation objectives, you’ll potentially have more time to steal valuables in the bank vault with a slower police response. There are certain variables you’ll need to handle in the bank too, though.
Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:
When Raul texted Lucia and Jason about the heist, he noted that while weapons will be available for you to use, you can bring your own preferred guns too . If you have a gun you’ve modded and like, make sure it’s on you before visiting. Anything with a higher rate of fire and shotguns are great. For Jason specifically, it’s helpful to have at least one non-sniper precision weapon with a magazine upgrade. Preparing your own weapons is especially helpful to do if you didn’t successfully escape with all the weapons and explosives crates from the Company Property mission . If you lost gear, there’s a chance the weapons you’re provided won’t have mods and you may not receive explosives. Stocking up on frag grenades is recommended as well.
As always, it’s wise to buff Jason and Lucia’s three stats before heading to Raul’s Planning Room. Make sure they each have three shots of Adrenaline and full Zombix before departing too. If you haven’t worked out to improve their stats, it’s helpful to have at minimum Jason’s Health and Focus improved to level 2. If you’re hoping for a perfect heist, I’d recommend taking time to build his Focus to level 3 .
You can stop by Nicole in the planning room before approaching the large table for some final safe cracking practice if you want it. If you haven’t practiced, I highly recommend trying it a few times. If you don’t Tap to Reveal
To begin, approach the table in Raul’s Planning Room and a cutscene of the entire crew begins. During it, Raul reviews the plan and everyone’s role. If you brought any longarms with you into the planning room, you’ll see them pack the guns into the bags when they head out.
The goal of the heist is to not set off alarms as long as possible and move as fast as possible. If you managed to successfully do every prep mission and don’t fail a single part of the heist , and move efficiently through each part to save time for bagging the money , you can get away with a huge take and little police resistance. This is incredibly challenging to achieve, so don’t sweat if you don’t get it perfect! So long as you did the prep missions, you'll still make it out with a decent haul. If you feel like the heist is going awry and you don’t like the outcome, you can always restart the mission (or reload a previous save) and try again.
If it isn’t clear, completing this heist perfectly is extremely difficult. While driving on a freeway in GTA 6, you might randomly stumble upon a traffic jam caused by an animal rights activist group called the Dodos Rising. This group has made it their mission to liberate animals from zoos, cages, and aquariums, as well as stop fracking. This official GTA 6 guide provides a full quest walkthrough for the Dodos Rising Optional Mission , including how to start Dodos Rising, and the recommended order you should complete the missions.
Need help completing any of the four missions in this questline? Click the links below to jump to:
While driving on a freeway, you may come across one of these Dodo protest groups. They will be blocking traffic and harassing a Leonida Animal Service vehicle.
As you approach, there will be two members of the Dodos Rising group at the back of the truck trying to break it open. You can target one of them after they ask for help and agree to help them. Using Focus Mode, you’ll see that there is a lock on the left handle of the truck. Shoot the lock with a pistol which will cause all the Dodos to cheer.
One of the members of the Dodos will open the back of the truck and climb in to rescue a polar bear. This doesn’t go so well. Once the polar bear’s cage is open, it will attack and kill the man instantly.
The polar bear will then jump out of the back of the truck and kill another member of the group. After that, the polar bear will run away, and all the protesters will flee. You aren’t given any clue what to do after this, and this isn’t even needed to start the Dodos Rising optional mission. Feel free to leave the area.
To start the Dodos Rising optional mission, you’ll need to visit an aquarium in Catalan Key, or a Monkey Lab in south VCIA. You can do the aquarium or the monkey lab in any order. For this guide, we will be doing the Dodos Rising option mission in this order:
After completing those missions, the overall mission will converge at the Fracking mission.
To begin the aquarium part of the mission, called Sister of the Sea, you’ll need to head to Catalan Key. Using Key Lento as a starting point, you’ll want to drive from the northeast bridge and follow the coastline up until you reach Catalan Key. This small island is mostly a parking lot, with the Vice City Oceanarium situated on the northeast section.
As you approach the Oceanarium, you’ll hear some shouting, and you can use Focus Mode to see where the noise is coming from. Approach the Oceanarium to see a woman with green hair standing next to a ladder, taking pictures of a guy painted like an orca – the man has glued himself to the Oceanarium sign.
The green-haired protester will explain that an orca is being held inside the aquarium, and their goal is to break it out and return it to the ocean. After some dialogue, you can offer help. The protester will get your phone number and tell you that they will be in touch.
That’s it for now; the pair will be chased off by a guard, and you will be free to leave. The protester, Rosebud, will contact you eventually.
Once rosebud sends you a text message, it’s time to return to the Oceanarium and help free the orca. Rosebud's location will be marked on your map with a small pink dodo bird, and this will be just south of the Oceanarium complex in a parking lot.
As you approach, you’ll spot a colorful van with its back doors open, and behind the van will be an inflatable pool with Rosebud sitting in it. Apprach Rosebud to begin the mission.
A cutscene will play with Rosebud explaining that the orca is about to be transferred to another aquarium. She will also have bathed herself in chum – this will be important later. The cutscene ends with Lucia entering the van. A timelapse will play to switch the time to nighttime, and Rosebud will open the van to tell you that it’s time to free the orca.
The mission begins with you following Rosebud into the aquarium. Just follow along with her and jump over the fence. A spotlight will go off, and a guard will approach you and Rosebud. You won’t have any weapons on you, so fistfight the guard until you knock him out.
Once done, you will follow rosebud over another fence where the guard fight took place. It will be dark, so feel free to pull out your flashlight, but you follow Rosebud as you both make your way to the orca. articles.chapeau: This GTA 6 guide covers the locations and rewards for the 9 Legendary Animals -- or Snapmatic Animals as they are called in Grand Theft Auto
articles.txt:
This GTA 6 guide covers the locations and rewards for the 9 Legendary Animals -- or Snapmatic Animals as they are called in Grand Theft Auto VI.
In addition to these 9 Snapmatic animals to hunt, there are two more you can also kill that aren't part of the set but give you big rewards from Bret. Speaking of Bret...
These missions begin in Chapter 2 where Jason's friend Bret will contact you and ask to meet. After completing the hunting tutorial with Bret, he will occasionally send Jason new "Target Decks" which will be a list of two to three animals for Jason to hunt down and turn in for money. While the Target Decks will have search areas on the map, occasionally, Bret will text Jason about an animal he heard about or encountered. Once you receive that text, a section will be added to your Activities index called Snapmatic Animals. These do not have search areas on the map but instead come with a vague clue as to where to find the animal.
You cannot just hunt down all the Snapmatic Animals using this guide page. You must have been given the clue from Bret before the animal spawns. In this guide, we will give you the clues, locations, and rewards for each of the Snapmatic Animals Bret wants you to hunt down. There are two Legendary Animals at the bottom of the page with no clues, however.
Your reward for each animal will be money, but you will get more money for a Pristine rating on a kill -- and we will recommend the weapons to use to get these clean kills.
The following two animals will not recieev location hints from Bret, as they are not technically considered "Snapmatic Animals". Though, hunting them and returning them to Bret will net you a big reward, and they will be tracked on the Animals progress tracker.
For more shooting activities, check out GTA 6's Shooting Ranges or regular animal hunting. You can find separate official guide pages for these activity here.

articles.txt:
This official GTA 6 guide contains a complete list of the cars Randy requests of you and their locations, including an image of each to help you identify them, and a map with circled areas you can find each car.
"Randy’s Wanted List" is a big list of cars that Randy, the vehicle fence you meet in Chapter 3 in Grand Theft Auto VI, curates for you. Once Randy has you steal the first car, the Granforma Zorrusso, he will give you the Key Cloner, allowing you to steal the cars on his list. The Key Cloner is also a key item (sorry...) in GTA 6 as it allows you to steal any car requiring a digital key.
The Static Cars are a list of cars that Randy will specifically tell you about in a hint. You cannot go to these locations and expect to find the cars he needs until he gives you the hint. The hint will mark a search area on your map. To get more of the Static Car locations, talk to Randy every time you drop off a car to see if he has a new car location for you to go to.
The Non-Static Cars are cars that can be found the moment Randy gives you the list. They won't have set spawn points, but can instead be found at dealerships, high-end properties, or car meets and we've provided maps for the potential locations of each.
In this guide, we will show you what every car on Randy's List looks like, and provided detailed locations to get them all.
Randy's static car locations require that he tells you where they are. If you go to these locations without the tip from Randy, the car will not be there. After stealing the first car, the Granforma Zorrusso, Randy will call and give you the Key Cloner, which allows you to steal high-end vehicles. Below is the full list of every static car Randy will tell you to go steal.
When approaching the north side of the search area, you'll see a damaged wall. Jump over the wall and then run east down the parking lot. Under the covered parking lot, turn right and you'll see the Granforma Zorrusso backed into a parking spot.
The Coquette can be found in the middle of the restricted area. It's a yellow supercar next to the water and a red shipping container. You can see it through the gate if you approach from the east.
When approaching the search area from the west, you'll be in front of a big mansion with a gate. Jump over the front gate. After jumping over the gate, look for a garage on the right. Open the garage to find the Pegassi Vitello inside.
When on the south side of the search area, go through the front door of the Sunrise Premium Autos dealership. Once inside, the banshee will be the convertible on the left. It'll be blue with a white racing stripe. (Get in and drive right through the glass for a fun easter egg trophy)
The easiest approach (but not the only one) is probably from the west side of the compound. Walk up the driveway and hug the left side to head toward the garage. When facing the garage, go around to the left to see an open window. Jump through the window. Inside the garage is a plane, with the Ascot Paragon sitting next to it.
Looking at the Estate from the west, the garage holding the car will be to the left of the main house. The garage is open in the image below, but it won't be when you first arrive. Just be aware that the area is swarming with armed guards that will shoot on sight.
The Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire will be location on the south side of the search area, but you'll need to enter from one of the two entrances on the north side, as there is barbed wire along the entire fence line. Look out for M7 gang members, as they'll attack you on sight.
The Pegassi Infernus is all the way up on the 7th floor of the parking garage. And since it's crawling with cops, making your way up from the ground floor can be a challenge. Start from the southwest corner of the parking garage and look for the yellow lift. Hop on the lift and ride it as high as it can go. Jump off the lift and head to the stairs, which is the door on the left. Climb the stairs until you reach the 7th floor, which is indicated by the giant seven. Then go through the door and see the Pegassi Infernus to the right.
When approaching the Tallaloko villa from the northwest, you'll see a stream of water flowing through a hole in the wall. Enter the villa through that hole. Once through the wall, find the road by the tennis court and follow it up. The cabins will be on your right. The Pegassi Tempesta will be in the driveway of the second cabin on the right.

The vault at Sinfrontera National Bank isn’t something that can be cracked easily. At Nicole’s suggestion, Jason and Lucia are sent to steal a safe the crew can use for practice before they hit the real deal. In this official GTA 6 walkthrough , you’ll learn how to steal the safe along with notes on a few choices and their outcomes in the Grand Theft Auto VI Chapter 3 main mission, Safe Word.
Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:
Visit the lockup in Stockyard to begin the mission. Nicole explains the safe you’re stealing is the personal version of the vault in the bank, making it an ideal practice device before the big day. Your target is on the first-floor office of a porn website owner’s house. Outside you’ll find a large pickup truck, a Bravado Bison 3800, with a large winch on the back. Get in with your partner. A few seconds later, Karim texts the mansion address. The porn mogul’s mansion is south in Peacock Bay’s Peacock Estates.
The drive down south is long, but busy. Karim and Nicole get in contact with extra information as Jason and Lucia chat. Karim makes a point to tell Jason and Lucia that this mission is meant to be quiet – excluding the whole "ripping a safe out of a wall" part. As you approach the guard station at the entrance of Peacock Estates, Jason automatically says they’re there to see about a pool and get let in immediately. Drive down and park on the right side of the street.
If you take a violent approach upon arriving at the home, you won’t get to participate in a Tap to Reveal You’ll also attract the attention of the estate security.
Lucia stays behind, leaving you as Jason to find a way in. The front gate is open just a bit, making for the perfect entrance. The two security guards at the front of the mission get together near the garage and look at a video shortly after you get on the property. So long as you stay crouched and keep your distance, they shouldn’t notice you. The front door is locked so you’ll need to go around the east side of the house. If you get caught Tap to Reveal
The first door here isn’t open, so you’ll need to keep walking around the house. Once you’re by the pool, sneaking around isn’t necessary. Go past the pool and around the back for another door, but no luck. The west side of the house it is. On the way, though, Jason is intercepted by Gil’s assistant, who assumes she’s the pool boy they’ve been waiting for. A cutscene begins as Jason is put to work.
Move to your first mark, the skimmer by the pool. Wait until the director calls for Jason to pick up the skimmer with Triangle/Y and move the pole back and forth in the pool as the scene plays out. Lucia makes her own commentary as she listens in from afar.
Next, the director tells Jason to look at Samantha, then to really notice her. You’ll be able to do anything other than skim the pool as soon as the new objective marker appears over Samantha. Hold the L2 / LT to focus on her, then when prompted, press and hold Triangle / Y until the director is satisfied. A little bit more pool skimming later and Jason gets his closeup. Move over and pick up the lotion.
As directed, spread the lotion on Sasha. You can move up and down Sasha’s back and rub it in with the left and right thumbsticks. Once that part is done, reapply lotion in your hands with R2 / RT then begin the whole lotion process all over again as they retake the shot.
Next is a "fight" with Rodney. Give him a few punches before the director calls for you to let him get some hits in. When it’s your turn to knock him out, hit him relentlessly to knock him out. If you take too long or if Rodney dodges too much, the director calls for Rodney to fake getting hit to move on the scene.

Jason is free to enter the mansion. Walk around the side of the house and go through through the door marked by the "actor's showers" sign. You can’t explore much of the mansion, but if you go left immediately, you can grab a Zombix from the bathroom counter. Continue through the hallway and enter the office doors on the right. articles.txt:
Looking to log on to the previous tenant’s laptop at the GTA 6 Chapter 3 safe house? There are three clues around the apartment you need to find before you can input the password. Random guessing won’t work, but this official GTA 6 guide will walk you through each step of this neat secret puzzle that unlocks some very useful freebies.
First, you need to interact with the following two items to get access to certain words:
Return to the laptop and input the following three choices as they appear: Muffins – Queen – 15
You’ll be able to tab through Vanessa’s tab and read her messages. The one you really should take a look at is a message on WhatUp from "Unknown." The message says there’s something for her in " LaPerle right next to Auntie’s Place and use 92665 ." She never responded.
You can translate her messages with her mom to English by pressing Triangle / Y when looking at the message.
The spot you’re looking for in La Perle isn’t on the map because the restaurant isn’t functional – no, it’s not Aunt Zola’s Soul Food, but Auntie's Place is close to it! Instead, the best way to get to the present location is by going to Aline’s Thrift Store .
Then, go through the rundown motel parking lot just next to the thrift store. You’ll see Auntie’s Place closed down in the lot. Just beyond it is a garage with a bow drawn near the door and a keypad. You can only interact with the garage if you've received the keypad code from the laptop .
Enter the code 92665 to open the garage. Inside, you'll find a pink car that was supposed to go to Vanessa, but now it's all yours!
In addition to getting the car, you'll unlock the Del Rio Boulevard Garage for free . And remember, you cannot interact with the garage keypad unless you've gotten the password for the laptop and look through Vanessa's messages.

articles.txt:
Dans GTA 6, voler une voiture ne suffira plus pour prendre la fuite tranquillement. Pour la première fois dans la saga, les véhicules devront être ravitaillés en carburant, tandis que les modèles électriques auront besoin de recharger leur batterie.
Nous suivre sur Google Comme dans la vraie vie, les voitures de GTA 6 disposent d'une jauge de carburant qui diminue au fil des kilomètres. Lorsque le réservoir approche de la réserve, le jeu prévient le joueur et lui indique les stations-service à proximité.
Selon les premiers essais rapportés par Kotaku , l'autonomie varie fortement selon les modèles et la conduite. Une sportive Banshee peut ainsi tomber en panne après un peu plus de 18 minutes de conduite rapide, contre plus de 29 minutes pour un grand pick-up.
Heureusement, Rockstar n'a pas poussé le réalisme jusqu'à imposer une longue attente à la pompe : le ravitaillement prend environ dix secondes sous forme de courte séquence animée.
Les véhicules électriques sont également concernés. Ils doivent être rechargés sur des bornes dédiées, réparties dans l'État fictif de Leonida. Là encore, impossible de rouler éternellement sans surveiller sa jauge.
Les stations-service proposent aussi de réparer les véhicules endommagés. Une fonctionnalité plutôt pratique pour les joueurs qui ont tendance à maltraiter leur carrosserie pendant leurs escapades.

GTA 6 voice actor: Game’s realism resonates with players
articles.chapeau: Big Mike Forbs portrays club owner Boobie Ike in the blockbuster game.
articles.txt:
( NewsNation ) — The actor who voices a criminal underworld character in “Grand Theft Auto VI” says the violent video game may, surprisingly, teach men a thing or two about being a good romantic partner.
Big Mike Forbs, who portrays club owner Boobie Ike, says the lead character in GTA 6, Jason Duval, is setting a good example — potentially, anyway. Players can choose to have the character do chores and home repairs and buy flowers while he waits for his significant other, Lucia Caminos, to come home from prison.
“A lot of people be focusing on the violence and saying, ‘Oh, what about the kids? Blah, blah, blah,’ but look, we got a man showing what you can do to make a woman happy,” Forbs told “NewsNation Prime” on Saturday. “When’s the last time you ask yourself that: Is my girl happy?”
Compared with the Duval character, he said, men may have to “step our game up.”
GTA 6, which has been described as a modern-day version of Bonnie and Clyde, launched this week to rave reviews and a record $3.8 billion in sales.
Forbs credits the success to the intense research that goes into the game, saying, “People just love the real.” The granular detail includes “Brazilian butt lifts” on dancers, he noted.
The actor says he helps support that sense of authenticity. Forbs noted that he hails from Miami, the model for the game’s setting of Vice City.
“I’m Miami for real. This is not no U.K. actor coming in and acting like he’s from Miami,” he said.

GTA 6 Cyberleek update: Everything leaked so far, what might be next
articles.chapeau: We thought the leaks were done, but we were wrong.
articles.txt:
Since August, someone (or perhaps a group of people) called Cyberleek has been very busy sharing various gameplay clips of Grand Theft Auto 6 . On Aug. 20, Take-Two Interactive, the parent company of GTA-maker Rockstar Games, filed subpoenas against Microsoft and Discord to try to unmask the leaker, followed soon after by subpoenas against Google and X Corp . Those filings specifically cited "stolen content," confirming that the Cyberleek videos are legitimate.
Prior to the August "Extended Look" on Netflix , the GTA 6 leaks represented the first real glimpse of gameplay from the hotly anticipated title. After the Netflix trailer, Cyberleek stopped posting for more than a month before suddenly reappearing in October with a 24-minute gameplay video and some other decidedly NSFW clips. We're not going to embed or link to any of these clips; however, they're easy enough to find on X or Reddit if you look hard enough.
At the time of publication, more than a dozen gameplay clips and map screenshots have been posted by Cyberleek that show different aspects of GTA 6 , including glimpses of cutscenes . The leaker did post some minor story spoilers in the most recent release, so be careful if you want to avoid them.
Map sneak peek 1: A small, cropped portion of the in-game world map, showing a location called Dalton Island.
Map sneak peek 2: Another cropped portion of the map showing locations called Tequesta Retreat, Gloriana Key, and Catalan Key.
Basketball video: A clip of protagonist Jason Duval throwing a basketball into a hoop in a mini-game.
Random video 1: A clip of Jason driving around for a little bit before beating up a truck driver.
Taser video: A clip of Jason driving at night, stealing a security guard's taser, and using it on him. Jason then repeatedly kicks the guard while he is on the ground.
Junkies video: A clip that appears to show a healing drug called Zombix. A tooltip indicates that Zombix's effects will weaken over time if the player uses it too much.
Plane video: A clip of Jason flying a plane over Vice City, with much of the game world visible below. At the end, whoever is playing the game in the clip shoots the word "LEEK" into a wall with bullets, suggesting the leaker has a playable build of the game .
Hypercar part 1: A clip of Jason driving a high-end sports car around Vice City.
Hypercar part 2: A clip of Jason driving the sports car some more, before committing armed robbery.
Strip club: Jason wanders around a strip club, then a short clip of an in-game cutscene is shown.
Gas station: Jason causes trouble at a gas station, steals a truck with a bed full of gasoline, and crashes and dies; more of the previous cutscene is shown.
Nudist colony: Jason explores a nudist hangout spot (where the NPCs are, obviously, nude) and attacks NPCs.
Nightclub: A pretty uneventful video of Jason walking around the interior of a nightclub.
Beach cycling: Jason riding a bicycle on a beach full of NPCs.
Video game store: Jason walking around a video game store with shelves full of fake video game boxes.
How does Cyberleek drive? Jason steals a hot rod and evades the police; the clip ends with a cutscene showing Lucia Caminos, the game's second playable character, for the first time. Caminos talks about someone who "drives like a bitch."
Lucia prologue: A four-and-a-half-minute video of a prologue introducing Caminos ; the clip includes minor story spoilers.
24-minute extended leak: A long video featuring multiple vehicular races, car customization, first-person gameplay, and both protagonists rendered in the nude.
Nude Lucia videos: Several videos of Lucia performing various in-game activities, such as walking around, driving, and parachuting, while completely nude.
The big 24-minute Cyberleek video in October ended with an allusion to some sort of long-term "project," the likes of which we know nothing about. However, the leaker has now threatened to release a "Full 200+GB playable build" of the game, played from beginning to end, if the Cyberleek memecoin reaches $30 million in market value. At the time of publication, the coin's value is at about $2.5 million, a far cry from that goal.
In addition, as of Oct. 12, websites associated with Cyberleek are hosting a poll, which is titled, "Lucia closeup 4k video." In the past, Cyberleek has hosted polls asking followers what clips to release next, with users voting using the leaker's memecoin. This strongly suggests new GTA 6 leaks featuring Lucia are coming soon.

Can teens play 'GTA 6'? What parents need to know.
articles.chapeau: A guide for parents who worry about saying yes or no.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI fans waited more than a decade for a new installment of the best-selling video game of all time. That includes teens who were toddlers when the game's last chapter debuted.
Now they've grown up and they're itching to not just play GTA 6 ; they're also eager to participate in the Grand Theft Auto discourse.
From the debate over killing or sparing a character named Arnold to cataloguing all the wildlife cameos to the game's hot soundtrack , GTA 6 is driving countless conversations amongst players, including teens.
But the game is rated 17+ and features adult content, including sex, strip clubs, drugs, graphic violence, and murder. So, many parents whose teens want to play GTA 6 will likely find themselves in the familiar yet tricky position of balancing their child's interests and social life with exposure to content they feel violates their family's values.
Dr. Brett Biller, a child psychologist at Hackensack University Medical Center, wants parents to know it's OK — even advisable, in his opinion — to say no to GTA 6.
Biller has no problem with video games in general. In fact, he acknowledges how online interactive games can have benefits, like socializing with friends over play.
Ultimately, however, he believes exposing tweens and teens to GTA 6 's hyperrealistic community violence is simply not worth it.
"The negative consequences can outweigh the positive impact," Biller says.
While research doesn't prove that video game violence causes aggressive behavior , Biller notes there's a correlation between between violence in the home and aggression. That makes Biller cautious about exposing kids and teens to violent video games.
Killing zombies, he notes, is much different than murdering human characters, and younger children don't consistently grasp the difference between fantasy and reality. Yet Biller says older teens can also struggle in this way, especially given the realism of GTA 6 . Plus, the game may normalize community violence by putting a teen player in the shoes of a thief or killer.
Meanwhile, teens with a history of witnessing or experiencing violence who play GTA 6 may find it difficult to manage the game's stimuli and their feelings about the content, Biller adds.
Beyond concerns about violence, parents may say no because they understand how playing GTA 6 will affect their child's mood, sleep, and personality.
"We, as caregivers, are responsible for making decisions that are in the best interest of our children," Biller says.
He recommends parents who won't permit their teen to play GTA 6 validate their child's frustration or fears of being left out.
Parents can also model how peer pressure is real and hard, because they feel it when other adults let their teen play GTA 6.
Biller says this conversation presents a good opportunity to help a teen understand that standing up for their principles isn't always easy. He suggests parents explore with their teen other activities they can do with friends instead of playing GTA 6 .
While some parents might feel better about playing alongside their teen, instead of the teen playing with friends, Biller says this approach is a "double-edged sword" that requires care and vigilance.
On one hand, parents who co-play have ample chances to point out and discuss concerning content or themes with their teen. On the other, co-playing can model to a teen that violence is fun or not a big deal.
In more cases than not, Biller finds that parents use this approach when they don't feel confident saying no or to justify their own choices.
Common Sense Media, a nonprofit organization that reviews and rates entertainment content, described GTA 6 as an "extremely mature crime game" for adults 18 and older.
Still, its review notes that only parents will know if their older teen is ready to play. Either way, Jasmine Hood Miller, director of family resources and content strategy for Common Sense Media, says parents should talk to their teen about the game.
Topics for discussion can include what looks fun about GTA 6 , how women are depicted in sex scenes and strip clubs, and whether they think they'd hurt people in the game, or have done so.
"It can be uncomfortable to talk about some of those topics," Miller says. "But honestly, if your kid is not talking to you, they're talking to someone else."
Miller adds that these conversations should feel low pressure and not like a lecture. Instead, Miller encourages parents to be curious and nonjudgemental.

Our earlier piece on the 209 GB Xbox dump and the missing emulator covered the first hours of the story. This analysis goes further and asks what a quick PC port would actually demand.

articles.t: GTA 6 PS5 and Xbox users protest after bans for sharing gameplay with nudity
articles.chapeau: Microsoft and Sony are cracking down on lewd GTA 6 gameplay captured by players. Xbox and PS5 gamers received suspensions for uploading clips featuring sunbathing or nude NPCs. Some critics think that sharing unedited footage from the approved Rockstar title should be safe.
articles.txt:
Rockstar 's new title carries a mature age rating for violence, strong language, and occasional nudity . Players are discovering the risks of sharing GTA 6 gameplay clips with adult-oriented content. An Xbox user received a 48-hour suspension for an upload depicting scantily-clad beachgoers . Meanwhile, a PS5 gamer suffered a longer punishment after taking a photo of a nudist colony.
By default, the Xbox Network automatically shares captured in-game footage with friends. Redditor sangobar documented how a beach clip triggered a flag, resulting in a two-day suspension. An email claimed that the media violated Community Standards or the Microsoft Services Agreement. Although the poster couldn't appeal, the ban didn’t prevent access to the single-player campaign .
Sangobar argues the video contained no nudity and the discipline was unjust. GTA 6 PS5 players are also finding the guidelines for promoting mature gameplay unclear. On social media, DerrickGott007 says he was given a one-month restriction on PSN social features . In this instance, NPCs wearing no clothing were the culprit.
Fans first learned the Leonida map included nudist colonies in a Cyberleek video from a development build. DerrickGott007 snapped an in-game photo in one of these locations before sending it to an acquaintance. The messaging system flagged the inappropriate imagery and responded accordingly.
It’s unclear if a Microsoft or Sony employee reviewed the footage, but both companies rely on AI-powered monitoring . Particularly with the beach example, a human may have recognized there was no infraction. A 2025 Digital Safety Content Report from Microsoft disclosed a high rate of successful appeals for false positives.
Some gamers believe it shouldn’t be their responsibility to filter out adult content. Xbox and PlayStation approved the GTA 6 release for their consoles, aware of its mature age rating. At worst, they should block the distribution of offensive media without penalizing a user.
Series X and S owners can reduce their chances of a ban by turning off automatic uploads. Until Sony comments, PS5 fans should be cautious about what GTA 6 gameplay they record and share on PSN messaging.

articles.t: GTA 6 could arrive on PC sooner than expected, thanks to a developer behind an unofficial Switch 2 Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake port
articles.chapeau: The project is still in the early stages and the game doesn't currently even boot.
articles.txt:
By Patrick O'Rourke Published Nov 21, 2026, 8:42 PM EST Patrick O'Rourke is XDA's News Editor and Entertainment Segment Lead. Previously, he was Pocket-lint's Editor-in-Chief, the Editor-in-Chief of Canadian tech publication MobileSyrup , and earlier in his career, he worked as the technology editor at the Financial Post and Postmedia . He's based in Toronto. Over the past 15 years, he's written thousands of articles. Patrick has also interviewed dozens of tech industry executives and covered GDC, E3, Gamescom, WWDC, Apple keynotes, Samsung Unpacked events and more. Patrick has a BA in journalism from Toronto Metropolitan University. Sign in to your XDA account Summary NotRexed is part of the team building Leonida, a project that aims to run the Xbox version of GTA 6 on PC. Leonida translates RDNA GPU code to SPIR-V and reads game assets from dumped Xbox images, but it currently lacks GTA 6 's executable. Cyberleek's leaked Xbox build of GTA 6, which comes in at 209GB, seems to be real. NotRexed , a key developer behind Hookshot , one of the first projects to bring the Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time to PC through static recompilation, says they're now working on an unofficial PC version of Grand Theft Auto 6 (the project was first announced on their Discord ). Leonida seems to be built around the leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 , which recently appeared online courtesy of Cyberleek , the same person or team behind major leaks surrounding the game from earlier this year.
According to Leonida's description, since the Xbox Series X/S CPU is x86-64 like a PC, the "game's code is loaded and run[s} natively." The team behind the project, which includes assistance from Claude and roughly 75 other contributors, claims that the console's system software has also already been reimplemented.
Additionally, the Xbox Series X/S's "precompiled RDNA GPU programs are translated to SPIR-V for Vulkan" and the GTA 6 "models, textures, and audio" are all read directly from the disc image, which users need to provide from their own dumped copy of the Xbox version of GTA 6.
Like similar porting projects, Leonida doesn't feature GTA 6 's game files or keys. Right now, the game doesn't even boot on PC because the project is missing the game's executable, which Cyberleek's recent leak of the Xbox version doesn't include.
Credit: Rockstar Users on Reddit report that Cyberleek's Xbox build of GTA 6 features roughly 209GB of data. Screenshots of the leaked directory structure are also circulating online (check one out below). I haven't verified that the torrent is available (it's likely being shared through private trackers). Cyberleek says they'll release the missing executable file once a countdown expires, but that they'll drop it early if their shady cryptocurrency reaches $15 million in market capitalization (because, of course, a cryptocurrency scam is connected to this).
It's unclear how long it will take to get GTA 6 running on PC, but if the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is any indication, it could arrive sooner than expected. While GTA 6 is now available on the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, Rockstar hasn't announced a PC version. Rumors point to an official PC release arriving somewhere between six months and a year from now, similar to GTA V .
Hookshot was briefly pulled from GitHub after a dispute between NotRexed and the rest of the team behind the project. It's back on GitHub now, though. MagicBean's Longshot , a fork of Hookshot, continues the original project, with most of the team shifting over. In other GTA 6 -related news, with PS5 Remote Play or a capture card, plus apps like Veyra and a powerful gaming PC, several people have been able to run GTA 6 at 60fps and above with DLSS5 .

GTA VI sur PC : Leonida et Xbox2Windows s'attaquent à la recompilation de la version Xbox
articles.chapeau: Leonida et Xbox2Windows tentent de recompiler nativement pour Windows la version Xbox Series de GTA VI. Shaders et outils avancent, mais le jeu ne démarre toujours pas sur PC.
articles.txt:
Trois jours après la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S , toujours sans version PC annoncée, la scène s'agite déjà sur GitHub . Le 20 novembre, à quelques heures d'intervalle, deux dépôts sont apparus avec la même ambition : faire tourner sous Windows le code de la version Xbox du jeu de Rockstar Games , sans émulateur. Leonida , du nom de l'État fictif où se déroule le jeu, a dépassé les 4 700 étoiles en une journée. Xbox2Windows , plus discret, en compte près de 900. Aucun des deux ne permet de jouer.
Les deux projets reposent sur le même constat : le processeur de la Xbox Series utilise l'architecture x86-64, comme les PC. Plutôt que d'imiter la console, il s'agit de reprendre son code et de réimplémenter les logiciels système qui l'entourent. La démarche diffère de celle des recompilations de Shadow the Hedgehog et Sonic 06 , qui doivent traduire le code écrit pour d'anciens processeurs. Ici, le gros du travail porte sur la puce graphique RDNA2 de la console et sur son Direct3D 12 maison.
Publié par ItsNotRexed , déjà auteur de Hookshot, le portage natif sur PC du remake de Zelda Ocarina of Time paru sur Switch 2 , Leonida affiche un bilan conséquent. Les 26 503 shaders de la version Xbox ont été extraits et traduits en SPIR-V pour l'interface Vulkan , et tous passent l'outil de validation spirv-val . Réserve de taille : 21 545 d'entre eux sont conçus pour des groupes de 64 fils d'exécution, natifs sur les puces AMD , et certaines opérations ne sont encore qu'approchées sur les cartes NVIDIA . Modèles 3D, textures et banques audio, musiques et radios comprises, sont déjà exportés.
Le reste est loin d'être bouclé. Le chargeur de l'exécutable n'est qu'un squelette, jamais testé sur le vrai programme, et la couche qui traduit le Direct3D 12 de la Xbox vers Vulkan n'affiche encore rien. Le dépôt ne contient ni le jeu, ni clés, ni exécutable. Il faut sa propre copie de la version Xbox Series 1.0.2.1, avec des fichiers déjà lisibles sur le disque, et environ 350 Go d'espace libre pour tout construire sur sa machine. Le verdict de l'auteur est sans ambiguïté : « Le jeu ne démarre pas encore. »
Signé R0Y00 et publié sous licence MIT, Xbox2Windows se présente comme un projet de recherche sur la recompilation statique des logiciels Xbox Series pour Windows. Le jeu n'y est jamais nommé, mais le dépôt se déclare sans lien avec Rockstar et Take-Two et précise que l'exécutable principal manque dans la copie étudiée. Ses expériences avancent par petites briques. Côté processeur, des fonctions x64 sont retraduites en C++ puis recompilées en programmes et bibliothèques Windows, mais uniquement sur des programmes de test écrits par l'équipe. Côté graphique, une sélection de shaders est convertie en DXIL pour Direct3D 12, quand Leonida mise sur Vulkan.
D'autres essais affichent des textures BC7 récupérées, lisent les données de scripts ou testent l'upscaler FidelityFX recompilé. Un outil de vérification graphique téléchargeable a déjà été lancé par la communauté sur plus de soixante cartes graphiques, des GTX 1070 aux RTX 5090 et Radeon RX 9070. Le dépôt reste toutefois honnête sur ses limites : l'exécution du code du jeu, son démarrage et ses performances ne sont « pas vérifiés » . Pour John Papadopoulos , de DSOGaming , il s'agit d'une première tentative d'ouvrir la voie au portage de jeux Xbox Series sur PC, utile à long terme mais sans intérêt immédiat pour les joueurs.
Les deux projets butent sur le même obstacle. Leonida assure que tout ce qui pouvait être fait sans l'exécutable est en place, et que le travail sur le démarrage commencera dès qu'un développeur en disposera. Le numéro de version visé ne passe pas inaperçu : 1.0.2.1, c'est aussi celui de la build Xbox de 209 Go que le groupe CyberLeek affirme diffuser par torrent, privée de son exécutable , promis contre la hausse de sa cryptomonnaie. Côté PlayStation, l'horizon n'est guère plus dégagé : l'émulateur KyTyPS5 ne lance pas GTA VI , qui exige en outre un firmware PS5 récent que personne n'a encore débridé.
L'annonce partage la scène. Certains y voient de quoi pousser Rockstar à avancer une version PC, d'autres rappellent que l'éditeur a les moyens juridiques de faire disparaître ce type de dépôt et doutent qu'une version jouable arrive avant d'avoir terminé le jeu à 100 % sur console. Une certitude, en attendant : aucun GTA VI jouable sur PC n'existe aujourd'hui, hors diffusion à distance depuis une console. Les vidéos qui prétendent le contrai

articles.chapeau: In briefGTA 6 leaker Cyberleek released what it claims is a near-complete 209 GB Xbox build via torrent but is holding back the main executable until its meme coin reaches a $15 million
articles.txt:
A notorious Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker is holding a potential PC version of the game hostage to a cryptocurrency payday, promising to release the final file needed to make a leaked build playable once its meme coin hits a $15 million market cap.
The leaker, who goes by Cyberleek, has released what it claims is a near-complete 209 GB Xbox build of GTA 6 from November 2026 via torrent, according to a report from PC Gamer .
The one piece withheld is the main executable, the file that would let modders begin emulating the game on PC, potentially bringing it to the platform long before Rockstar Games intends.
You can now act on the news you read: Go long or short Bitcoin with perpetual futures, all from your Decrypt Money Account.
Here’s the crypto catch. Cyberleek says it will release the executable on Nov. 23 regardless, but will drop it early if its token, called CYBERLEEK, reaches a $15 million market cap. That’s half the $30 million target the leaker floated in October.
The pressure tactic doesn’t appear to be working: the token is trading around $0.002 as of the weekend, with a market cap of roughly $1.3 million, more than $13 million short of the goal. The coin is down some 20% on the week, but the numbers will fluctuate wildly given the very thin liquidity on a small cap coin.
The setup has drawn open skepticism that it’s a cash grab, or worse. Observers have warned it could be an attempt to pump the coin before a rug pull, the crypto term for abandoning a token after luring buyers in. Cyberleek has also claimed to hold a PS5 build as a fallback if the Xbox files can’t be made to work.
The episode sits at the increasingly busy intersection of crypto, piracy, and AI. Modern Xbox games are architecturally closer to PC software than PlayStation titles, and AI coding tools have accelerated the kind of decompilation work that makes fast ports plausible, the same dynamic behind a wave of AI-assisted game ports this year.
It also caps a chaotic launch window for GTA that crypto has repeatedly crashed. One trader banked around $66,000 on a GTA 6 meme coin amid ticker confusion, and the game’s disc-free, digital-only release has fueled broader debate, with GameStop’s CEO arguing that digital-only games have hurt consumers.
None of the leaked files have been independently confirmed as genuine, and there is still no official GTA 6 PC version; Rockstar, famously litigious, could respond with legal action rather than a port.

articles.txt:
Bluffton, OH From movies and tv to the lastest fashion trends and lifestyles. We are your one-stop for everything.
Remember Cyberleek? The Grand Theft Auto VI leaker with a meme coin and a dream claims to have dumped nearly the entire Xbox build of the game on launch day, and says the last missing piece is coming soon. It’s déjà vu, because we’ve been through this song and dance before.
On Oct. 10, Cyberleek tied a full build release to their coin’s market value hitting $30 million. The coin never came close and flamed out within days. This isn’t the first time it has crashed, either: Tom’s Hardware reported that the leaker cashed out roughly $250,000, mostly from accumulated trading fees, in late August, hours before Rockstar’s official gameplay reveal and just before the coin plunged.
That’s a bit like a magician announcing the big reveal and slipping out through the kitchen with the cash register. And what did we get in the meantime? Some Lucia clips picked by a fan poll and requested by basically nobody else, delivered with the energy of a guy who found a loophole in the “no refunds” policy.
Now the target has dropped to $15 million. Cyberleek says the final file is coming Monday, Nov. 23, no matter what, or sooner if the coin hits $15 million first. Half price, like a clearance rack at a Blockbuster that somehow survived into 2026 (OK, one of them did). Nothing says confidence like cutting your own ransom note in half and hoping nobody notices.
According to PC Gamer , Cyberleek says every file has been released except the main executable, from what the leaker calls the “full November 2026 build” of the game. Reports put the download at roughly 200 GB, with several outlets citing 209 GB. If that’s accurate, they’ve handed over the whole pantry and kept the oven. It’s like mailing someone every ingredient for a birthday cake, then standing outside their house holding the matches and asking for a tip.
One important caveat: as of this writing, nobody has confirmed the build is genuine. Everything about the build itself is Cyberleek’s claim. And files claiming to be Cyberleek builds have been linked to malware before, so this isn’t the torrent to get curious about.
Cyberleek’s pitch is that “this community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps.” Fine. Honestly, kind of compelling. I’ve watched grown adults argue about frame rates in a Walmart parking lot, so I understand the stakes. The catch: no working Xbox Series X emulator exists yet, according to Notebookcheck, so “inside a week” is doing a lot of heavy lifting.
GTA 6 has no official PC version, so Cyberleek is pitching emulation of the leaked console build as the way in. And if the Xbox build can’t be made to work, they say they’ll go after a PlayStation 5 build instead, a fallback they call “most likely never required.” Because apparently one console isn’t enough.
According to launch-day reports from PC Gamer and IGN, the meme coin was sitting at roughly $1.8 million to $1.9 million. Reaching $15 million in a few days would take an eightfold jump, the kind of growth you normally only see in a sourdough starter during lockdown, and even those eventually die in the back of the fridge. So the date is the trigger that actually matters: Monday, Nov. 23.
Maybe Cyberleek has the goods. Maybe they have a folder of loading screens and a very vivid imagination. Nobody knows, and my money’s on the second one, but if the build is real, Rockstar has a headache. Either way, we’ll find out soon. Grab some popcorn, and maybe a sturdy lawn chair.

articles.txt:
We've been covering the hacker or hackers known as Cyberleek for months now, as they've attempted to profit from releasing footage of Grand Theft Auto VI well in advance of the official launch date. In that time, Cyberleek dropped a manifesto (the " CYBERLEEK Edict ") championing consumer rights while simultaneously launching and cashing out on a meme coin (named $CYBERLEEK, of course) before disappearing into the void.
Many people assumed that once the game was fully released, we would see the last of Cyberleek, who was thought to possess only an early build of the game. But the pesky leaker, having already avoided all of Take-Two Interactive's attempts to unmask him , is back with an even larger threat. On the Cyberleek website (which we won't link to for legal reasons), Cyberleek claims to have posted a 209 GB Xbox build of GTA VI : "It is done. CL holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI , and it is going out by torrent." The best tech deal this week The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile
But, as always with Cyberleek, there is a catch. The download does not include the executable, so the game isn't playable from those files, though. Reddit users have posted what they say are assets from the leak . Cyberleek is threatening to release the executable on Nov. 23. "The countdown is the timer for the final file. Zero, and the executable drops, no conditions. Unless the CYBERLEEK token reaches 15 million market cap first — then it drops immediately."

articles.txt:
À peine sorti sur PS5 et Xbox, GTA 6 agite déjà la scène PC : le hacker Cyberleek promet un port jouable en une semaine grâce à une fuite Xbox. Entre build incomplète, memecoin et pression sur Rockstar, cette promesse intrigue autant qu’elle inquiète.
Depuis la sortie de GTA 6 le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, beaucoup se demandent encore quand la version PC arrivera. Un pirate qui se fait appeler Cyberleek promet d’abréger l’attente en rendant GTA 6 PC jouable en « moins d’une semaine » grâce à une fuite Xbox.
Dans un message du 19 novembre relayé par PC Gamer, le hacker affirme : « CL détient la build complète de novembre 2026 de Grand Theft Auto VI, et elle part en torrent, maintenant ». Il décrit une build de développement Xbox d’environ 209 Go et annonce un compte à rebours jusqu’au 23 novembre pour lâcher le fichier clé.
Selon les premiers retours de la scène sécurité comme VX‑Underground , les fichiers ressemblent à de vrais assets de Grand Theft Auto VI : textures, sons, scripts, données du moteur. Mais l’archive Xbox serait privée de son exécutable principal, le fameux .exe qui sert de chef d’orchestre. Sans lui, ces 209 Go restent un puzzle impossible à lancer.
C’est ce fichier que Cyberleek promet de publier, en expliquant qu’il s’agit « d’une build Xbox, pas d’une build PC » mais que « cette communauté l’aura émulée en moins d’une semaine, au‑delà de 30 fps ». Pour l’instant, rien ne prouve que l’exécutable soit réellement en sa possession.
Derrière la promesse de GTA 6 PC rapide se cache aussi un objectif financier. Le pirate lie la mise en ligne anticipée de l’exécutable au succès de son jeton crypto $CYBERLEEK : il réclame 15 millions de dollars, soit environ 14 millions d’euros de capitalisation, après un premier seuil à 30 millions de dollars, près de 28 millions d’euros, jamais atteint.
Sur le plan technique, cette promesse fait tiquer les spécialistes. Aucun émulateur Xbox Series X|S public ne sait aujourd’hui lancer un jeu aussi lourd que GTA 6 . Même avec le kit Xbox GDK , proche de Windows, il faudrait soit émuler tout l’environnement console, soit recompiler le code vers un exécutable PC, ce qui demande d’ordinaire des mois de travail.
Cette agitation attire déjà de faux sites « GTA 6 PC gratuit » et des launchers piégés par des malwares. Télécharger ces builds reste illégal en France, avec à la clé risques de poursuites et de vol de données.
Officiellement, Rockstar Games n’a toujours pas annoncé de version PC de Grand Theft Auto VI , même si des rumeurs évoquent un lancement début 2027 . L’ancien directeur technique Obbe Vermeij estime qu’un portage PC plus rapide serait dans l’intérêt du studio pour couper l’herbe sous le pied des ports sauvages dopés aux outils automatisés et des hackers comme Cyberleek .

Entre menaces de leak, chantage au memecoin et protection juridique agressive de Rockstar, la promesse d’un GTA 6 PC jouable en une semaine tient plus du pari risqué que d’une feuille de route crédible.

Add preferred source An anonymous leaker known as Cyberleek has distributed a roughly 209 GB Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto 6 by torrent while withholding the main executable needed to attempt a PC port. The file is promised for Nov. 23, but would be released early if the CYBERLEEK meme coin reaches a $15 million market cap - down from an earlier $30 million target. The token was trading near $0.002 at a value of about $1.3 million, far short of the goal, and has drawn accusations of a pump-and-dump scheme. Key Elements Cyberleek GTA 6 Rockstar Games CYBERLEEK token Grand Theft Auto PC Gamer Kaspersky GameStop PlayStation 5 Xbox A figure using the handle Cyberleek has posted what is described as a roughly 209 GB Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto 6 to torrent networks, but is holding back the one file that matters most to anyone hoping to run the game on a computer: the main executable.
According to PC Gamer, the leaker has attached a financial condition to that final piece. Cyberleek says the executable will be published on Nov. 23 either way, but will be released early if the CYBERLEEK meme coin reaches a $15 million market capitalization - half the $30 million threshold floated in October.
The market has not cooperated. The token was changing hands near $0.002 over the weekend, putting its value at roughly $1.3 million, or more than $13 million below the stated trigger. It has shed about 20% over the past week, though pricing on a micro-cap asset with very little liquidity can swing violently in either direction.
The missing executable is the piece that would allow modders to begin the work of recompilation - adapting console code so it runs on PC hardware - potentially delivering a playable version long before Rockstar Games plans to sell one. The leaker has said the process could take about a week once the file is available, and has also claimed to hold a PlayStation 5 build as a fallback should the Xbox files prove unusable.
None of the leaked material has been independently verified as authentic, and Rockstar has announced no PC version of the game. The publisher, which has a long record of litigating against leaks and cheats, could pursue legal action rather than tolerate a port.
Skepticism has been loud. Critics have described the arrangement as a shakedown or, worse, an attempt to inflate the coin ahead of a rug pull - the crypto maneuver in which a token's backers abandon it after attracting buyers.
Note: Market figures reflect thin trading in a small-cap token and can change sharply.
The episode lands at the intersection of three trends that have been converging all year: crypto speculation, game piracy and AI-assisted coding. Modern Xbox titles are architecturally closer to PC software than PlayStation releases, which shortens the path to a workable port, and AI programming tools have sped up the decompilation work that such conversions require.
It also extends a turbulent launch window for Grand Theft Auto 6. Crypto traders have repeatedly tried to profit from the game's release, including one who captured about $66,000 amid confusion over ticker symbols. The title's digital-only, disc-free format has separately drawn criticism, with GameStop's chief executive arguing that all-digital games have hurt consumers.
The leak has arrived alongside a wave of fraudulent downloads. Security firm Kaspersky has logged 27,416 detections of GTA 6-related malware and unwanted software since June, according to ZDNET, with fake PC versions ranging from crude AI-generated clones to files designed to hijack machines for crypto mining or to steal personal data. The only official release remains the PlayStation 5 edition; PC players can currently stream it through Sony's Remote Play app.
Rockstar's habit of staggering platforms is central to the frustration driving interest in the leak. Red Dead Redemption 2 reached PC about a year after consoles, and Grand Theft Auto 5 took nearly two years.
For the industry, the stakes go beyond one title. If major new releases can be played free on other platforms within days of launch, publishers lose revenue that funds subsequent development - a threat that falls hardest on smaller studios. The likely defensive response would be tighter always-online requirements, which tend to inconvenience paying customers most.

CyberLeek has reportedly uploaded more than 200 GB of GTA VI XBOX game files online, but there is still one important file missing from the release: the main executable.
The files first appeared online on November 19, shortly after GTA VI’s launch. The package reportedly contains a large portion of the game’s Xbox development files, but without the executable, users cannot properly access or run the game.
According to Rockstar Games community researcher Lucas7yoshi , the uploaded files are indeed from an XBOX build of GTA VI. However, he pointed out that this is an older version of the game, as it does not even include the separate censorship version for Australia and New Zealand.
More importantly, the game’s assets are encrypted with a key obtained from the main executable. This means that simply downloading the files is not enough to access their contents.
CyberLeek initially announced that the missing executable would be released on November 23, regardless of whether its cryptocurrency reached a certain market value.
However, the group also introduced a condition that could make the release happen earlier. The original target was a $15 million market cap for its CYBERLEEK token. This requirement has since reportedly been lowered to $6 million.
According to GTA community member PLTytus , the token currently has a market cap of around $1.44 million. He also reminded followers that CyberLeek had promised to release the executable once its poll ends on Monday at 6 PM CET, even if the market cap target is not reached.
This means November 23 could be an important date for anyone following the situation, although there is still no independent confirmation that the missing file will actually be released as promised.
One of CyberLeek’s biggest claims is that the community could get the XBOX build running on PC within a week, potentially achieving performance above 30 FPS. However, this is far from guaranteed.
The uploaded files are from an XBOX version of GTA VI, not a native PC build. Even if the missing executable becomes available, getting the game running on PC would require additional work from developers and the emulation community.
For now, there is no confirmed playable PC version coming from this leak, and Rockstar Games has not announced a PC release date. It is also worth remembering that the authenticity and completeness of the entire package have not been independently established.
